# Simulation benchmark download and unified directory

In this chapter, all the storage, authentication, checkpoint download, and execution directories used by the benchmark are set up first. The variables used here will be reused in subsequent tutorials for RoboCasa365, DexJoCo, DISCOVERSE, RoboWits, and Unitree G1, so as to avoid writing data, checkpoints, and caches into the source code repository.

## 1. Recommended Directory

First, enter the root directory of the Every Embodied repository, and then define the tutorial and large file directories:

```bash
export EVERY_EMBODIED_ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
export WORK_ROOT=${WORK_ROOT:-$HOME/physical-ai}

# AMD 开发者云的持久化 PVC 可使用：
# export WORK_ROOT=/workspace/physical-ai

# AUP 镜像若约定 /home/jovyan 持久化，可使用：
# export WORK_ROOT=/home/jovyan/physical-ai
export SRC_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/src
export DATA_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/datasets
export MODEL_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/checkpoints
export RUN_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/runs
export CACHE_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/cache
export ENV_ROOT=$WORK_ROOT/envs
export HF_HOME=$CACHE_ROOT/huggingface
export PIP_CACHE_DIR=$CACHE_ROOT/pip
export UV_CACHE_DIR=$CACHE_ROOT/uv

test -f "$EVERY_EMBODIED_ROOT/README.md"
mkdir -p "$SRC_ROOT" "$DATA_ROOT" "$MODEL_ROOT" "$RUN_ROOT" "$ENV_ROOT" \
  "$HF_HOME" "$PIP_CACHE_DIR" "$UV_CACHE_DIR"
```

The source code only stores the code and small configurations. Data, models, videos, and training outputs are placed in separate directories, which facilitates the deletion of caches without accidentally removing training results.

## 2. AMD Device Pre-check

PyTorch, the [tensor computing framework], still uses the `torch.cuda` device interface on ROCm [AMD Open Compute Platform]; when checking the backend, `torch.version.hip` must also be examined.

```bash
python - <<'PY'
import torch

print("torch:", torch.__version__)
print("hip:", torch.version.hip)
print("available:", torch.cuda.is_available())
print("device:", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if torch.cuda.is_available() else None)
assert torch.cuda.is_available()
assert torch.version.hip is not None
PY
```

The JAX［High-performance array computing framework］ project conducts matrix pre-checks separately:

```bash
JAX_PLATFORMS=rocm python - <<'PY'
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

print("jax:", jax.__version__)
print("backend:", jax.default_backend())
print("devices:", jax.devices())
x = jnp.ones((64, 64), dtype=jnp.float32)
print("sum:", float((x @ x).sum().block_until_ready()))
assert jax.default_backend() == "rocm"
PY
```

## 3. Hugging Face Authentication and Downloading

The public model can be downloaded directly; for restricted dataset, you need to apply for access on the web page first, and then log in via the terminal. The token［access token］ is only written into local credentials and not into scripts or Notebook［interactive notebook］.

```bash
hf auth login
hf auth whoami
```

It is recommended to use `--local-dir` of `hf download`. After interruption, re-execute the same command to continue the transfer. First, define the repository and local directory, and you can run it directly after replacing the variable values:

```bash
export HF_MODEL_REPO=robocasa/robocasa365_checkpoints
export HF_DATASET_REPO=DexJoCo/DexJoCo-Datasets-LeRobot
export LOCAL_MODEL_DIR="$MODEL_ROOT/robocasa365"
export LOCAL_DATASET_DIR="$DATA_ROOT/dexjoco-lerobot"

hf download "$HF_MODEL_REPO" \
  --repo-type model \
  --local-dir "$LOCAL_MODEL_DIR"

hf download "$HF_DATASET_REPO" \
  --repo-type dataset \
  --local-dir "$LOCAL_DATASET_DIR"
```

Use `--include` when selecting only a directory from a repository:

```bash
export HF_SUBDIR='pi05_pretrain_human300_multitask_75000/**'
hf download "$HF_MODEL_REPO" \
  --include "$HF_SUBDIR" \
  --local-dir "$LOCAL_MODEL_DIR"
```

## 4. Headless Rendering

EGL [Windowless Graphics Rendering Interface] when the remote device has no desktop window:

```bash
export MUJOCO_GL=egl
export PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
```

The minimum verification is not "the program can be imported", but completing a `reset → step → render → MP4`:

```bash
ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 \
  -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height,r_frame_rate \
  -of default=noprint_wrappers=1 "$RUN_ROOT/robocasa365/smoke/episode_000.mp4"
```

## 5. Two-layer running protocol

Each benchmark is divided into two layers:

| Level | Purpose | Minimum Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| smoke［Smoke Test］ | Verify environment, assets, action dimensions, and video links | 1 task, 1 short round, MP4, environment information |
| formal evaluation［Formal Evaluation］ | Statistically analyze model capabilities | Fixed task, fixed seed［Random Seed］, complete denominator, per-round results |

Before training, a smoke test is conducted. However, the official results are only summarized from the complete evaluation directory.

## 6. Unified run directory

```text
runs/{benchmark}/{model}/{run_name}/
├── run_config.json
├── environment.txt
├── train.log
├── metrics.jsonl
├── checkpoints/
├── eval/
│   └── {task}/
│       ├── eval_info.json
│       └── videos/
└── summary.json
```

`run_config.json` must record at least the upstream version, task, model, action/observation dimension, camera, control frequency, training steps, and evaluation seed［random seed］. `summary.json` must be aggregated from per-round files, and the manual entry success rate should not be filled in manually.

## 7. Check for download completion

```bash
export PROJECT_DIR="$SRC_ROOT/robocasa"
export DATASET_DIR="$DATA_ROOT/dexjoco-lerobot"
export CHECKPOINT_DIR="$MODEL_ROOT/robocasa365"

test -d "$PROJECT_DIR/.git"
test -n "$(find "$DATASET_DIR" -type f -print -quit)"
test -n "$(find "$CHECKPOINT_DIR" -type f -print -quit)"
df -h "$WORK_ROOT"
```

After confirming that the source code, data, and model directories are not empty, and after reserving the training checkpoint and video space, proceed to the corresponding tutorial.
